snippet.title: Heirs of the Fountains, Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
⚔️ **Heirs of the Fountains – Official Trailer**

Enter the kingdom of **Elarion** in a pixel-art action-platforming adventure.

Take control of two siblings with unique powers, overcome dangerous levels, uncover hidden secrets, defeat fearsome creatures, and face powerful guardians on your journey to rescue **Lady Julia** from the clutches of the witch **Morwenna**.

🔥 Classic action and platforming
🗺️ Explore the kingdom of Elarion
💀 Face unique creatures and bosses
🔎 Discover hidden secrets and collectibles
🏆 Unlock achievements throughout your adventure

🎮 **Wishlist Heirs of the Fountains on Steam:**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5129980/Heirs_of_the_Fountains/

**Heirs of the Fountains** is coming to PC on Steam.
